outcome: Systemic immune imbalances (peripheral leukocyte disorganization, local immune imbalance, local collagen disruption)
cohort: The study included plasma and fetal membrane samples from PROM patients and normal control (NC) groups.
finding: The study identified 1,459 differentially expressed circRNAs in PROM and suggests that structurally stable circRNAs may predispose to PROM by mediating systemic immune imbalances, inflammatory processes, and extracellular matrix regulation.
cross-section timing: Fetal membrane tissue and prenatal plasma samples were collected.
